chunks: The Thamud and 'Ad denied the consequential calamity.

key_terms.بِالْقَارِعَةِ: the striking calamity / the Day of Judgment

ai.seo_question: Who were the Thamud and 'Ad and what did they deny?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Al-Qari'ah is often interpreted as the Day of Judgment itself, characterized by its overwhelming noise and terror, serving as a direct parallel to the historical destruction of Thamud and 'Ad. This verse underscores the continuity of divine retribution, reminding believers that the same power that struck down these ancient nations remains the ultimate arbiter of the Hereafter.
